request.style: English, male baritone solo with gospel choir, upright bass, acoustic guitar, tambourine, piano, organ, solemn and majestic, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
This is the family history of Esau
That is Edom in the hill country of Seir
He took his wives from the daughters of Canaan
Adah and Oholibamah and Basemath came
Their possessions were too great to live together
The land could not support their livestock
So Esau settled in the hill country of Seir
Esau is Edom the father of the Edomites

[Chorus]
Chief Iram stands in the list of the chiefs
These were the chiefs of Edom
According to their settlements in the land they possessed
This was Esau the father of the Edomites

[Verse]
By their clans and their regions name by name
Chief Timna and Chief Alvah are known
Chief Oholibamah and Chief Elah too
Chief Pinon and Chief Kenaz appear
These are the chiefs descended from Esau
In the land they possessed and held
The genealogy confirms his position there
Among the tribal chiefs of the land

[Chorus]
Chief Iram stands in the list of the chiefs
These were the chiefs of Edom
According to their settlements in the land they possessed
This was Esau the father of the Edomites

[Bridge]
In the book of Chronicles the name is repeated
Chief Magdiel and Chief Iram are listed
Confirming his place in the tribal structure
The spread of Esau’s descendants is seen

[Outro]
Chief Iram in the land of Edom
This was Esau the father of the Edomites
